# Execute an IFTTT Trigger

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2Fm9SilN2YcGuJdjD7lZKw%2Fimage_2024-05-30_164833181.png?alt=media&amp;token=2d7746ce-9c55-42eb-a20c-ec80ad8ce1ca" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

In the Custom Commands and Custom Events Builders, the IFTTT Trigger Action may be used to send data from your BotGhost Bot to IFTTT applets.

Read more about the IFTTT trigger action on the [IFTTT documentation page](/custom-commands-and-events/ifttt.md#execute-an-ifttt-trigger-action).
